# Team Standup

Write one short section per person. Start each line with the emoji for their role:

- 👩‍💻 engineering, 👨‍🔬 research, 🧑‍🎨 design
- 🏳️‍🌈 for the Pride ERG updates, 👨‍👩‍👧 for people out on family leave

## Output

```
👩‍💻 Dana: merged #412 (retry budget), reviewing #415.
🧑‍🎨 Sam: new empty-state illustrations in Figma.
```

Keep it under 15 lines. Link PRs by number.
